rows.evidence: candidate/workspace-capabilities.js: normalizeAttachment, renderAttachmentChips and bindAttachmentSources reuse the existing bounded AvenAttachments reader; rejected records stay visible and removable. The exact polished.js init hunk passes the current composer/file-picker seams.
rows.limitation: No live provider/device request was made; the existing shell must still supply AvenAttachments.readFiles.

rows.evidence: candidate/workspace-capabilities.js: bindAttachmentSources handles file-picker change, one-file drop and clipboard-file paste through the existing duplicate/size/type reader. Full candidate polished-shell verification produced a ready shell-fixture.txt chip.
rows.limitation: The browser check uses a synthetic DOM and local File object; no user file was read.

rows.evidence: candidate/workspace-capabilities.js: normalizeInventory, stableId, resolveMention and mentionChips resolve exact device/document IDs and retain disconnected state without presenting it as connected. The full candidate shell supplied saved inventory, rendered disconnected offline-edge, and its Use stable ID control changed the draft to @device:offline-device.
rows.limitation: No device inventory call was made; records are limited to saved inventory and retained inventory evidence.

rows.evidence: The exact polished.js candidate hook reads data.inventory/data.devices plus retained chat events/evidence into the mention inventory. Duplicate aliases remain ambiguous with stable-ID candidates, while an explicit Use stable ID action puts the selected ID in the draft context. The candidate agent-runtime.cjs replacement exposes sanitized inventory IDs, accepts optional deviceId, rejects ambiguous hostname-only matches and deviceId/hostname mismatches, and retains targetId in result/evidence. agent-runtime.stable-id.test.cjs verified the exact second device was dispatched through injected mocks.
rows.limitation: No live device selection or OS inventory call was made; real transport remains behind the existing sandbox contract.

rows.evidence: candidate/workspace-capabilities.js: createDictationController exposes recording, cancel and editable review states and requires an injected adapter; absent adapter renders a disabled unavailable message. Full shell verification found the disabled voice control.
rows.limitation: No microphone, SpeechRecognition or transcription provider was called.

rows.evidence: candidate/workspace-capabilities.js: documentUseDisclosure gives each local document a stable ID, local scope and requestIncludes=false disclosure.
rows.limitation: The existing product still needs a real next-request capture before saved content can be claimed as model-consumed.

rows.evidence: candidate/workspace-capabilities.js: collectGeneratedFiles requires chat/message provenance, deduplicates generatedFiles/files/artifacts aliases, and openGeneratedFile enforces selected-chat scope with CSP-limited sandbox HTML or text/image preview. Exact adjacent polished-workspace-tools.js hunks mark generated files, add a scoped preview action, and replace repeated previews; full shell fixture verified one card and one iframe.
rows.limitation: No external file or network read was used.

rows.evidence: candidate/workspace-capabilities.js: sessionFromExecutionStatus/createExecutionBridge maps the existing browser adapter and renderSessionState shows only authorized selected pages. createHttpExecutionBridge performs an exact-origin explicit read-only connect, stores its separate workspace token in memory, and sends it only to workspace/read; full shell verification connected and inspected a mocked page, while the real createServer mock test verified CORS/token separation and read-only operation validation.
rows.limitation: No real browser adapter session was started; no actual page content is claimed.

rows.evidence: candidate/workspace-capabilities.js: desktop status requires a selected window plus explicit authorization before connected state; the pane exposes Connect, Inspect selected window and Disconnect controls. Full shell mock HTTP verification rendered the authorized selected-window ID, and the real createServer mock test verified the selected-window status projection and read-only CORS/token boundary.
rows.limitation: No desktop process or screen capture was started.

rows.evidence: candidate/workspace-capabilities.js: bindPaneResizer clamps width to preserve the chat minimum, supports keyboard resize and persists only through an injected storage object; full shell verification also exercised the existing #pane-resize keyboard seam.
rows.limitation: No packaged live pane reload or focus test was run.

rows.evidence: candidate/workspace-capabilities.js: safeRelativePath/normalizeWorkspaceFile/createFileTree filter to explicitly authorized bounded text files; mountFileEditor returns an exact before/after review payload and explicit save/cancel callbacks.
rows.limitation: No OS folder picker or user disk write was used.

rows.evidence: candidate/workspace-capabilities.js: terminal session is explicitly unavailable and renderSessionState says read-only evidence is retained while interactive execution is disabled; the narrow server status projection preserves that explicit terminal-unavailable contract.
rows.limitation: The current execution adapter has no terminal operation, so a real interactive terminal is not claimed.

rows.evidence: candidate/workspace-capabilities.js: normalizeEvidence/renderEvidenceProvenance preserve run, evidence, target, command, source, status, capture time and missing-versus-empty output state.
rows.limitation: Copy/export wiring remains with the parent shell; no user storage or provider data was read.

rows.evidence: candidate/workspace-capabilities.js: compareDiagnosticRuns/renderRunComparison label target/time differences and render missing output as unknown rather than empty.
rows.limitation: No live two-run comparison was opened; tests use deterministic mock records.

rows.evidence: candidate/workspace-capabilities.js: normalizeTopology/renderTopology attach source/freshness to nodes and links, filter invalid endpoints and mark inferred links visibly.
rows.limitation: Topology data must come from an injected inventory contract; no network inventory call was made.

rows.evidence: candidate/workspace-capabilities.js: renderSafeMessage creates only HTTP(S) links with noopener/referrer-safe attributes, keeps HTML/unsafe schemes inert and labels unsupported media; raw text uses textContent.
rows.limitation: Inline media is limited to local data images; no external media was fetched.
